fee_notes: Standard fee is $75,000. Reduced to $5,000 for existing franchisees adding a project within 100 miles of an existing project. Also includes a non-refundable Initial Marketing Program Membership Fee of $5,000 (waived for certain existing franchisees).
raw_excerpt: You must pay us a non-refundable initial franchise fee (the "Initial Franchise Fee") of $75,000, which is due when the Franchise Agreement is signed by you and us.
